From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@avatech.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic owner delegation and ephemeral credential proof request

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We started our Whistic profile cleanup and hit two items we need Redwood's help with:

1) Owner delegation: we want to move the Whistic profile owner to our security ops mailbox (security@avatech.com) so our automation can pick up evidence uploads. Can Redwood initiate the owner change from your end or do you want us to open a vendor request inside Whistic?

2) Ephemeral proof for temp service account: our procurement team needs a short manifest showing a transient service account was used to upload artifacts (name, creation timestamp, TTL, and proof-of-deletion). Whistic accepts a CSV manifest or a signed PDF.

Quick ask: can you confirm an expected handoff window and whether you can provide the ephemeral manifest and a short SOC2 excerpt (high-level scopes only)? We don't need full reports in the portal, just an excerpt that states in-scope services and any subservice organizations.

I attached a snapshot export we pulled for context (avatest_whistic_export_20260809.zip).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if easier.

Best,
Emily Turner
Security Program Manager | AvaTech
security@avatech.com
AvaTech (www.avatech.com)

- Do you need the manifest signed or is a signed hash sufficient?

I'm attaching a small template we use for owner-delegation and proof handoffs to keep the portal change tidy.

3) SOC excerpt: Mina attached a one-page excerpt that states in-scope services and confirms no third-party subservice org exceptions beyond our listed cloud provider (packet-cloud).
